title: In Vivo Smooth Muscle Cell-Specific CRISPRi Perturb-seq - PCSK9i
author: João Pinho Monteiro
materials: Chromium GEM-X Single Cell 3’ Kit v4
Reagents Tamoxifen (Sigma-Aldrich; CAS T5648-1G) Sunflower seed oil (Sigma-Aldrich; CAS S5007-259ML) 100% Ethanol Oral gavage needles (appropriate gauge/length for adult mice) + syringes

Endpoint : - Sacrifice after 9 weeks of HFD . Reagents: - Liberase TM medium Thermolysin (Roche #05401127001) - Reconstituted in HBSS to 26 units/mL. - After reconstitution, divide into single-use aliquots, as performance degrades significantly withfreeze-thaw. - Elastase (Worthington #LS002279), stock solution has variable concentration - HBSS, calcium, magnesium, no phenol red (Gibco # 14025092) - PBS Equipment: - Fine dissection scissors (e.g. FST 14058-09) - 5mL Round Bottom Polystyrene FACS Tubes w/ 35um Strainer Cap (Falcon # 352235). - Pre-cooled centrifuge at 4°C w/ swing bucket

steps.title: Prepare 20 mg/mL tamoxifen solution
steps.instruction: Mix 9 parts sunflower oil with 1 part ethanol (e.g., 900 µL oil + 100 µL ethanol) to make the vehicle, add 1000 µL of this vehicle to 20 mg tamoxifen, let dissolve overnight at 37 °C until clear, then store at 4 °C for up to 1 week.

steps.title: Administer tamoxifen by oral gavage
steps.instruction: At 7–8 weeks of age give two oral gavage doses of tamoxifen 72–96 h apart, each at ~0.2 mg per gram body weight. Example: a 30 g mouse receives 6 mg (0.3 mL of the 20 mg/mL stock).

steps.title: Gather reagents and equipment for AAV injection
steps.instruction: Collect AAV stock (titer as provided), sterile DPBS, isoflurane, 0.5 % proparacaine ophthalmic solution, U‑100 BD Ultra‑Fine Short Insulin Syringes, 31G (BD #BD328438), isoflurane vaporizer with induction chamber and nose cone, and a heating pad.

steps.title: Prepare virus dilution
steps.instruction: Thaw the AAV on ice; if using only part of a vial, aliquot the remainder and refreeze on dry ice, storing at –80 °C. Dilute the virus in sterile DPBS to a final concentration of 1 × 10¹² vg/mL, preparing 100 µL per mouse, load into a 31G insulin syringe and minimize bubbles.

steps.title: Perform retro‑orbital AAV injection
steps.instruction: One week after the first tamoxifen dose, place a mouse in an induction chamber, start isoflurane at 3–4 % (0.8–1.0 L/min) until breathing slows to ~1 breath/s, then maintain at 1–2 % with a nose cone. Position the mouse on its side, gently press the upper and lower eyelids to protrude the globe, apply one drop of 0.5 % proparacaine, dab excess with sterile gauze, and inject 100 µL of virus using a 27–30 G, ½″ needle at a 30–45° angle (bevel down, lateral to the medial canthus). Withdraw the needle slowly, close the eyelids, apply mild pressure with gauze, and let the mouse recover in a paper‑lined cage on a heating pad, monitoring every 15 min until ambulatory.

steps.title: Start Western high‑fat diet
steps.instruction: Begin the Western high‑fat diet at the time of the mPcsk9 AAV injection and maintain the diet for 9 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare enzyme digestion solution
steps.instruction: On ice, make 1 mL of enzyme mix containing 77 µL Liberase TM (26 U/mL) and 16 µL Elastase (125 U/mL) to achieve 2 U/mL of each enzyme in the final solution, and add 907 µL HBSS. Keep the mixture on ice while harvesting the aorta.

steps.title: Perfuse mouse and harvest aortic root
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the mouse with isoflurane (3–4 %, 0.8–1.0 L/min) to surgical depth, perform a midline skin incision, open the abdominal cavity, puncture the diaphragm, complete a thoracotomy, incise the right atrium for exsanguination, insert a 25–27G needle into the left ventricle or ascending aorta and perfuse ~10 mL sterile PBS until tissues blanch, then dissect the aortic root, open it longitudinally, and wash three times with PBS in a 12‑well dish on ice.

steps.title: Enzymatic digestion of aortic tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer the aortic root to a 12‑well dish containing 1 mL of the enzyme mixture, incubate at 37 °C for 30–45 min (longer for older or heavily calcified tissue), then mince on ice with scissors for ≤5 min until mostly dissolved. Pipet the suspension up and down 20–30 times, examine under a microscope for single cells, and if digestion is incomplete incubate an additional 10–15 min at 37 °C (avoid longer incubations).

steps.title: Prepare single‑cell suspension for FACS
steps.instruction: Transfer the digested suspension to a 1.5 mL tube, centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min, carefully remove supernatant, resuspend the pellet in ~300 µL HBSS (adjust as needed), optionally coat collection tubes with 10 % BSA, pass the cells through a 35 µm strainer, and sort dual‑positive tdT⁺ (SMC‑derived) and GFP⁺ (AAV‑transduced) cells by flow cytometry.

steps.title: Generate 10x single‑cell library
steps.instruction: Pool tdT⁺/GFP⁺ cells from 3–5 mice to obtain >8,000 cells, then follow the 10x Genomics Chromium GEM‑X Single Cell 3′ v4 protocol (Gene Expression User Guide CG000731) and the Feature Barcoding guide (CG000389), specifically Step 2.3C followed by Step 4 for guide‑library construction.

description: Abstract (JPM Edited 2/25/26) This protocol describes an in vivo smooth muscle cell (SMC)-specificPerturb-seq workflow enabling targeted gene repression and single-cell transcriptional profiling during atherosclerosis. Using Myh11 CreERT2 ; ROSA tdT/+ ; dCas9 KRAB mice, dCas9-KRAB expression is induced in adult SMCs via tamoxifen administration. One week after tamoxifen induction, mice receive a single systemic AAV injection via retro-orbital delivery under isoflurane anesthesia to introduce sgRNAs targeting genes of interest or non-targeting controls. At defined endpoints, aortic roots are harvested and enzymatically dissociated to generate single-cell suspensions. Dual-positive tdTomato⁺/GFP-reporter⁺ cells are isolated by FACS and processed using the 10x Genomics Chromium platform for single-cell RNA sequencing and CRISPR guide capture. This integrated workflow enables high-resolution, lineage-traced functional genomics in vivo , allowing assessment of SMC state transitions and gene regulatory perturbations. Conditional smooth muscle cell dCas9-KRAB knock-in allele with lineage tracing [JPM2] We have obtained several lines of genetically modified mice from other laboratories, and combined alleles to undertake experiments outlined in here. To lineage trace vascular smooth muscle cells (SMC), we employed a SMC-specific mouse Cre allele ( Myh11 CreERT2 ; Tg Myh11-CreERT2 ; 019079; JAX) combined with a Cre-responsive reporter gene (tandem dimer Tomato, tdT ) inserted at the ROSA26 locus ( ROSA tdT/+ ; B6.Cg-Gt(ROSA)26Sor tm14(CAGtdTomato)Hze /J ; 007914; JAX) Adding a conditional dCas9-KRAB knock-in ( dCas9 KRAB ; B6.129S6- Gt(ROSA)26Sor tm2(CAG-cas9*/ZNF10*)Gers /J; 033066; JAX) mutation with these alleles has created the experimental mice, Myh11 CreERT2 , dCas9 KRAB , ROSA tdT/+ , that are both lineage traced for the SMC lineage and have SMC specific expression of dCas9-KRAB . All mice are on C57Bl/6 background. Detailed Description of dCas9-KRAB knock-in allele -
